This chapter is steam's strength reborn as electricity-era convenience: the §3Kinetic Processing Array§r folds advanced recipes into a single line, the §3Mega Steam Turbine Array§r burns steam straight into EU, and the §3Crust Matter Aggregator§r and the §3Cluster§r pull mining and processing under one roof.

They still run on steam — just at absurd scales, so your reservoirs and mains grow with them.

Along the main line through hub logistics and the singularity depths, this chapter awaits — the road is long, so make home comfortable first.

§8§oConvenience is technology at its most considerate.§r
